reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Beautiful colonial hotel with impeccable service. The afternoon tea is a must.

reviews.author: James K.
reviews.text: Great location and wonderful gardens. Rooms are a bit dated but very clean.

reviews.author: Amina W.
reviews.text: Stayed here for a conference. Excellent facilities and staff.

reviews.author: Peter O.
reviews.text: Good value hotel in the city center. Breakfast buffet is solid.

reviews.author: Grace N.
reviews.text: Convenient location for business trips. Rooms are comfortable.

reviews.author: Michael T.
reviews.text: Exceptional luxury hotel. The pool area is stunning and the service world-class.

reviews.author: Catherine L.
reviews.text: Beautiful African-inspired decor throughout. The spa is incredible.

reviews.author: David R.
reviews.text: Excellent conference facilities. Food quality is superb.

reviews.author: John D.
reviews.text: Iconic nyama choma experience! The unlimited meat service is incredible.

reviews.author: Lucy W.
reviews.text: Fun atmosphere and great for groups. The soups and desserts are excellent too.

reviews.author: Brian M.
reviews.text: Touristy but worth it. The meat is well seasoned and service is attentive.

reviews.author: Emma S.
reviews.text: Lovely garden setting with fantastic international menu. The lamb is outstanding.

reviews.author: Tom O.
reviews.text: Great brunch spot. Beautiful outdoor seating and creative cocktails.

reviews.author: Sophie A.
reviews.text: Best fine dining in Nairobi. The tasting menu is a culinary journey.

reviews.author: Daniel K.
reviews.text: Impeccable service and beautiful presentation. The wine list is excellent.

reviews.author: Rachel N.
reviews.text: Fresh seafood with a beautiful view. The prawns are divine.

reviews.author: Kevin M.
reviews.text: Great riverside dining. Excellent seafood platter and friendly staff.

reviews.author: Nancy W.
reviews.text: Cozy spot with great European cuisine. The mushroom risotto is amazing.

reviews.author: George P.
reviews.text: Consistently good food and friendly service. The patio is lovely.
